items.title: Show HN: Open-source, real-time object tracking for live video feeds
items.contentSnippet:
I type "forklift" on a live warehouse camera, and tamserve finds and tracks both forklifts, including the one driving in. Then I add "person" without stopping it.
tamserve runs Meta's SAM 3 on live camera feeds. SAM 3's own tracker handles one recorded video at a time, runs at about 8 fps, and runs out of memory on long videos. tamserve uses SAM 3 to find objects every few frames and a lightweight tracker (EdgeTAM) to follow them in between, with one copy of each model shared across all your cam

items.title: Show HN: Goethe – turn your computer into an inference engine
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm Matteo from meshapplied (YC W27), building this with Peter and Janos.
We think you can and should own your inference, so we built software that actually supports that. Goethe turns a Linux machine with an NVIDIA GPU into an API your OpenAI, Anthropic compatible clients can call.
```
curl -fsSL https://goethe.sh/install.sh | bash
goethe start
```
